csv_project_name: CI For SR 912 Michigan Ave Bridge Removal
csv_agency: State of IN Department of Transportation
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Indiana, Department of Transportation, may be seeking a consultant to provide Construction Inspection Services on Contract bundle at SR 921 and Michigan Ave to include bridge removals, rehabilitations and bridge replacements. The selected firm shall provide construction inspection services for construction Contract B-44980. The anticipated Letting Date is February 10, 2027. The projected time period of need for construction inspection through substantial completion is estimated from April 1, 2027 through November 1 2028. The CONSULTANT's personnel shall work under the INDOT Area Engineers or their designated representative. INDOT anticipates needing a total of 1 Project Engineer/Supervisor for the full contract duration for a total of 4,000 hours and 1 Project Inspector in 2027 at 1,700 hours and 2 Project Inspectors in 2028 at 4,200 hours during the course of this Contract. The work type and the contractor's schedule will ultimately determine the length of time each Project Engineer(s)/Supervisor(s) and Project Inspector(s) will work on this contract. INDOT may require personnel to work in any season, work for up to twelve (12) hours per day, or work at night. The CONSULTANT shall furnish all construction field testing equipment necessary to sample and test materials in accordance with INDOT procedures. The CONSULTANT shall furnish all necessary safety equipment needed for inspection and sampling and testing of materials. The consultant shall provide local personnel to the project such that neither lodging nor subsistence expenses will be incurred. The Letter of Interest (LOI) must specify the names of the Project Engineers/Supervisors and Project Inspectors who will be supplying the services on the construction contract that align with classifications listed above. Also, a map showing the residential locations of these personnel must be provided in the LOI. Personnel identified in the LOI who are not full-time employees at the time of LOI submittal shall be identified with explanation of employment status. The LOI must identify the specific subject area certifications that personnel have obtained through the INDOT Certified Technician Program (CTP) unless the personnel are exempt. Information on this program can be found at: http://www.in.gov/indot/2403.htm INDOT will not reimburse for any time or expense incurred in obtaining certifications at any time. INDOT does not allow consultants that performed design for the contract to be the prime consultant for inspection and does not allow these consultants to provide the Project Engineer/Supervisor services. See the INDOT Conflict of Interest Policy for more information. The INDOT Area Engineer and the Consultant will schedule the Scoping Meeting within two (2) weeks of the Notice of Selection. The selected consultant's fee proposal shall be due 30 calendar days after the selection date for this RFP item. A field overhead rate will be used for this contract. Consultants without audited field overhead rates may propose a field rate at the time of contract negotiation. This contract will utilize the INDOT eInvoice application.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Inspection Services, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering

title: Construction Inspection Services for SR 912 / Michigan Avenue Bridge Removal and Bridge Bundle
short_description: Construction inspection for bridge removals, rehabilitation, and replacement works in Hammond, Indiana.
project_scope: Consultant construction inspection services for INDOT construction contract B-44980 covering a bundle at SR 921 and Michigan Avenue, including bridge removals, bridge rehabilitations, and bridge replacements. Anticipated construction period is from April 1, 2027 through November 1, 2028. INDOT anticipates staffing of 1 Project Engineer/Supervisor for about 4,000 hours, 1 Project Inspector in 2027 for about 1,700 hours, and 2 Project Inspectors in 2028 for about 4,200 hours. The underlying construction contract value is stated as 33.6 million, with total construction cost stated as 52.9 million.
services: Construction inspection services, field testing and material sampling, project engineer/supervisor services, project inspector services, and support under INDOT Area Engineers. Disciplines requested include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, inspection services, structural engineering, and traffic design engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- This is primarily a construction inspection assignment, not a structural design or planning commission.
- The bridge-related scope is generally relevant to sbp's sector interests, but the tender does not seek concept, object, or structural design.
- No special structural features, spans, or innovative lightweight/sustainability aspects are described.
- INDOT explicitly excludes consultants that performed design from being prime for inspection, limiting strategic design entry.
- Could be of marginal interest only as a local inspection/support role, which is outside sbp's core profile.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents: Total Construction Cost stated as 52.9M. Converted and reported as USD 52,900,000.
fee_explanation: No explicit consultant fee stated. The notice mentions a construction contract value of 33.6M and total construction cost of 52.9M, but provides no inspection budget or fee percentage for the consultant services.
references_qualifications: LOI must name the proposed Project Engineers/Supervisors and Project Inspectors. A map showing residential locations of these personnel must be included. Personnel not employed full-time at LOI submission must be identified with explanation of employment status. Personnel must identify specific subject area certifications obtained through the INDOT Certified Technician Program unless exempt. Consultant must provide local personnel so that no lodging or subsistence expenses are incurred. Consultants that performed design for the contract may not be the prime consultant for inspection and may not provide Project Engineer/Supervisor services.
